🇮🇹 Trastevere Rome
Relatively saferBy day AverageBy night

Trastevere is Rome's best-known nightlife and dining district on the west bank of the Tiber, a maze of narrow medieval streets that is quiet and picturesque by day but fills with bars, restaurants and crowds after dark.
